&e&l=== IIC Player Guide ===&r

&e&lCore Concept&r
&7IIC adds dynamic difficulty based on your industrial progress. More machines = stronger mobs.

&e&lDifficulty Scaling&r
&7Pollution → Stronger Mobs → Higher Challenge

&e&lPollution System&r
&bTemporary Pollution: &7Generated by GT machines, spreads, absorbed by nature&r
&bPermanent Pollution: &7Accumulates, never removed, increases base difficulty

&e&lZombie Block Breaking&r
&cEnabled when difficulty >= 10&r
&7Edit config/improvedmobs/common.toml: &c"Difficulty Break AI" = 10.0&r
&7(Default is 0 = ALWAYS breaking!)

&e&lThree-Axis Difficulty&r
&bTime Axis: &7Grows with MC time&r
&bVoltage Axis: &7Higher GT tier = bigger bonus&r
&bPollution Axis: &7More pollution, harder mobs

&e&lRecommended Settings&r
&a• Difficulty Break AI: 10 (NOT 0!)&r
&a• Use /im industrial debug

&e&lDifficulty Values&r
&b5-10: &7Early game&r
&b20-50: &7Mid game&r
&b50+: &7Late game
